decisions.subject: iri_minting
decisions.resolution: normalize Unicode labels to ASCII before CamelCase minting
decisions.critic_reasoning: This is an identifier hygiene mechanism, not a geological judgment.
decisions.justification: Preserves readable stable local names for accented labels in any domain.

decisions.subject: public_comments
decisions.resolution: emit NLDs or clean label-based comments and retain critic text only in evidence
decisions.critic_reasoning: This separates public ontology annotations from internal workflow evidence.
decisions.justification: Prevents implementation directives from leaking into public comments.

decisions.subject: imports_and_property_labels
decisions.resolution: emit configured imports and labels for every used object property
decisions.critic_reasoning: Import and label completeness is a pipeline concern.
decisions.justification: Lets consumers resolve upper-ontology semantics without local domain or range copies.

decisions.subject: vug
decisions.resolution: drop the incompatible existential restriction
decisions.critic_reasoning: A vug is an immaterial pore site formed through dissolution, but the configured generated_by property is restricted to material geological objects and earth materials.
decisions.justification: Retains vug as a pore site and avoids asserting a property outside its published domain.

decisions.subject: micropore
decisions.resolution: drop the incompatible existential restriction
decisions.critic_reasoning: A micropore is an immaterial pore site. Its origin may involve dissolution, but generated_by is constrained to material entities in GeoCore.
decisions.justification: Preserves the pore classification without changing the upper property semantics.

decisions.subject: graben
decisions.resolution: drop the incompatible continuant-part restriction
decisions.critic_reasoning: A graben is a fault-bounded depressed site. A fault is a geological structure pattern, not a continuant part that an immaterial site can bear under BFO mereology.
decisions.justification: Keeps the graben and half-graben hierarchy while avoiding a category-invalid part assertion.

decisions.subject: in situ facies
decisions.resolution: drop the incompatible continuant-part restriction
decisions.critic_reasoning: Facies is modeled as a generically dependent pattern and cannot bear material grains as continuant parts.
decisions.justification: The constituent statement belongs on a material facies bearer, not on the facies pattern.

decisions.subject: in situ facies
decisions.resolution: drop the incompatible continuant-part restriction
decisions.critic_reasoning: Facies is modeled as a generically dependent pattern and cannot bear material growth forms as continuant parts.
decisions.justification: The constituent statement belongs on a material facies bearer, not on the facies pattern.

decisions.subject: muddy spherulitestone
decisions.resolution: drop the incompatible continuant-part restriction
decisions.critic_reasoning: This class inherits the facies pattern branch, so a material mud part creates the same BFO category clash.
decisions.justification: Avoids treating a facies pattern as a material whole.

decisions.subject: muddy spherulitestone
decisions.resolution: drop the incompatible continuant-part restriction
decisions.critic_reasoning: This class inherits the facies pattern branch, so a material grain part creates the same BFO category clash.
decisions.justification: Avoids treating a facies pattern as a material whole.

decisions.subject: rework facies
decisions.resolution: drop the incompatible continuant-part restriction
decisions.critic_reasoning: Rework facies is modeled as a generically dependent facies pattern and cannot bear material clasts as continuant parts.
decisions.justification: Retains the facies concept while removing a category-invalid material part.

decisions.subject: reworked carbonate
decisions.resolution: drop the incompatible continuant-part restriction
decisions.critic_reasoning: This class is placed under the facies pattern branch, so a material grain part is incompatible with its current ontological category.
decisions.justification: Avoids changing the frozen taxonomy beyond the smallest coherent correction.

decisions.subject: reworked carbonate
decisions.resolution: drop the incompatible continuant-part restriction
decisions.critic_reasoning: This class is placed under the facies pattern branch, so a material growth-form part is incompatible with its current ontological category.
decisions.justification: Avoids changing the frozen taxonomy beyond the smallest coherent correction.

decisions.subject: basement high
decisions.resolution: model the basement high as a material body of rock
decisions.critic_reasoning: A basement high denotes a physical elevated basement block, while the current structural-high parent is modeled as an informational geological structure.
decisions.justification: Makes the retained continuant-part-of-basement statement compatible with BFO.

decisions.subject: basement high
decisions.resolution: replace the defined-class genus with Body of Rock
decisions.critic_reasoning: The definition should describe a material basement body, not an abstract structural pattern.
decisions.justification: Keeps the part-of-basement differentia while removing the category contradiction.

decisions.subject: continental margin
decisions.resolution: model the continental margin as a site
decisions.critic_reasoning: The continental margin is a spatial geological region that can contain or locate basins, not a generically dependent structural description.
decisions.justification: Makes the located-in relation from passive-margin basin compatible with BFO.

decisions.subject: reservoir rock
decisions.resolution: broaden the material genus from Sedimentary Rock to Rock
decisions.critic_reasoning: Reservoir behavior is a role or disposition of a rock body and does not require sedimentary origin.
decisions.justification: Implements the unanimous expert objection without restricting valid igneous or metamorphic reservoir rocks.

decisions.subject: reservoir rock
decisions.resolution: broaden the defined-class genus from Sedimentary Rock to Rock
decisions.critic_reasoning: The equivalent-class definition must match the broader primitive parent or the sedimentary restriction would remain logically inherited.
decisions.justification: Completes the unanimous expert correction in both asserted and defined semantics.

decisions.subject: mud
decisions.resolution: drop the universal-looking silica constitution claim
decisions.critic_reasoning: Mud may contain silica-bearing particles, but mud as a general sediment kind is not necessarily constituted by silica.
decisions.justification: Implements the unanimous expert rejection of this overgeneralized relation.

decisions.subject: CQ4
decisions.resolution: retain NOT ANSWERABLE and defer connecting axioms
decisions.critic_reasoning: The frozen evidence does not identify a safe universal occurrence axiom linking every post-depositional process or structure to a material geological object.
decisions.justification: Preserves coherence and avoids inventing a universal geological claim.

decisions.subject: CQ6
decisions.resolution: retain NOT ANSWERABLE and defer connecting axioms
decisions.critic_reasoning: Dimensions and positions require selected bearers and locations, but no reviewed universal pairs are present in the frozen inputs.
decisions.justification: Avoids fabricating object-to-quality or object-to-site links.

decisions.subject: CQ8
decisions.resolution: retain NOT ANSWERABLE and defer connecting axioms
decisions.critic_reasoning: Association between stratigraphic units and reservoirs is context-specific and needs reviewed instance or class pairs.
decisions.justification: Avoids promoting an unreviewed domain association to a universal restriction.

decisions.subject: CQ10
decisions.resolution: retain NOT ANSWERABLE and defer connecting axioms
decisions.critic_reasoning: Formation and interval ages require reviewed temporal links to named age individuals, which the frozen inputs do not provide.
decisions.justification: Avoids inventing age assignments and keeps Tier C behind the coherence gate.
